newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Most member states back private pigmeat storage.
newsitem.headline: Most member states back private pigmeat storage.

text.p: A Danish request to farm ministers for the introduction of European Union funded private storage for pigmeat won the support of most other member states on Monday.
"Only Italy, Spain, Portugal, Luxembourg and the United Kingdom did not support the idea," a Commission official said.
Denmark wants private storage aid introduced for pigmeat waiting to be exported to Japan when a current moratorium on imports ends there in July. Exports of pigmeat from the EU
were stopped under GATT (General Agreement on Tariffs and Trade) rules allowing for a halt on the trade once a three year average limit has been exceeded. The decision is a Commission
responsibility but a spokesman said on Monday that the weight of opinion expressed in favour of storage aid would be carefully noted by farm Commisisoner Franz Fischler.
